variants.name: K2C1
variants.summary: The rail-equipped upgrade that replaced the original K2 as the Republic of Korea Armed Forces' standard-issue rifle from 2015, adding a flat-top receiver, quad-rail handguard and a collapsible stock without changing the gas-operated action or the 5.56 mm NATO chambering.
